verified.description: Confirmed no TrialBalance* or *ReportBuilder* PHP classes exist in lib/Service/; no bookkeeping-trial-balance spec previously existed in openspec/specs/ (only in openspec/changes/).
spec.md authored with Status: proposed, Scope: shillinq, Tier: T2, REQ-TB-001 through REQ-TB-006, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN scenarios, ADR-022 + ADR-031 cited.
proposal.md authored with kind: config, Affected Projects, Scope, Risks, Rollback, Open Questions.
design.md authored with Reuse Analysis, D1-D4 decisions, Declarative-vs-imperative decision table, Seed Data (none — purely computed), Risks, Migration Plan.

GLLine.x-openregister-aggregations.trialBalanceOpening declared: filter periodId < param.period AND GLTransaction.state != reversed, groupBy accountNumber, operations: openingDebit (sum amount where side=debit), openingCredit (sum amount where side=credit).

Reversed-transaction exclusion filter declared on all three trial-balance aggregations (trialBalanceOpening, trialBalanceMovement, trialBalanceClosing): GLTransaction.state != reversed. Lines remain queryable but excluded from movement totals per REQ-TB-002 D4.

GLLine.x-openregister-aggregations.trialBalanceClosing.invariants.debitCreditBalance declared: SUM(closingDebit) = SUM(closingCredit), errorShape with TRIAL_BALANCE_IMBALANCE code and delta field per REQ-TB-003.

Bookkeeping > Trial Balance menu entry added (order: 20, icon: TableColumnWidth, route: TrialBalance); TrialBalance page added as type: index with aggregation: trialBalanceClosing, 7-column layout (account, opening Dr/Cr, movement Dr/Cr, closing Dr/Cr), period queryParam with openFiscalPeriod default per REQ-TB-005.
Drill-through URL template declared on TrialBalance page rowLink: /index.php/apps/shillinq/general-ledger?period={periodId}&account={accountNumber} per REQ-TB-004 and D2.

Resolved: three composed aggregations (trialBalanceOpening + trialBalanceMovement + trialBalanceClosing). OR's aggregation engine does not yet support temporal-bucket discriminators in a single-pass query. Closing uses compose primitive. Annotated in Declarative-vs-imperative decision table and Open Questions.

Aggregation note added under TrialBalance entity: explains three-aggregation pattern, reversed exclusion, balance invariant, ADR-031 declarative path, reference to lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json.
